Root cause: The bug was caused by an incorrect class name reference in the `SecurityUtil.fetchServiceTicket` method. Specifically, the code was attempting to load the class `sun.security.jgss.krb5`, which does not exist, instead of the correct class `sun.security.jgss.krb5.Krb5Util`. This led to a failure in fetching the service ticket due to the inability to find the required class for Kerberos security operations after the changes made in HADOOP-6941.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by an incorrect class name reference in the `SecurityUtil.fetchServiceTicket` method. Specifically, the code was attempting to load the class `sun.security.jgss.krb5`, which does not exist, instead of the correct class `sun.security.jgss.krb5.Krb5Util`. This led to a failure in fetching the service ticket due to the inability to find the required class for Kerberos security operations after the changes made in HADOOP-6941.
